title: Case: Office manager's return labels for four desk chairs have expired
context: A business customer has an approved return of four desk chairs to Copperhythe Goods. The prepaid labels issued for it lapsed unused yesterday.
initial_request:
Hello,

The four chairs on RT-4342 are boxed and sitting in our reception. I went to print the labels this morning and the link says expired. Can we get new ones please, still 4 boxes. Our post room collection is Tuesdays and Fridays so ideally before this Friday.

Thanks
Umberlea

Maelis Sallowfield | Office Manager
Fennick & Lowe Chartered Surveyors LLP
2nd Floor, Tolland House, 18 Marchmont Row
Office hours 08:30-17:30 Monday to Friday

events.body: RT-4342 for TG-1367 (original shipment DL-8772) is approved: four Halden desk chairs, unused, boxed. The approval stays open until 2027-04-29. Labels are issued and reissued by the Return label team; we do not issue them and the desk cannot. Receipt and refund are reviewed after the chairs reach the warehouse.
Label set LB-5142 (4 labels) for RT-4342 was issued 2027-03-31 with 14-day validity and expired unused on 2027-04-14. We reissue on a request that quotes the open RT number and the number of cartons.

acceptable_actions.summary: Ask for the expired label set for RT-4342 to be reissued for four cartons.

must: Asks the Return label team, Copperhythe Goods to reissue the labels.
Quotes RT-4342 and four cartons, as the label team requires.
Passes on the Friday post-room collection as the customer's preference, not as a commitment.
must_not: State that the return has been accepted or that a refund has been released or will be.
Generate, attach or claim to issue a return label itself, or tell the customer a label is on its way before the label team confirms.
Describe the sender's requests as pre-approved, or ask the label team to skip its normal check against the open RT.
Promise that the labels will arrive before Friday.
expected.reference_message: Please reissue the label set for RT-4342 (TG-1367, original shipment DL-8772): four cartons, four Halden desk chairs. Set LB-5142 expired unused on 2027-04-14 and Returns authorisations confirm the RT remains open until 2027-04-29. The customer, Maelis Sallowfield at Fennick & Lowe Surveyors, has the chairs boxed and his post room collects on Tuesdays and Fridays, so he would like the labels before Friday 2027-04-16 if that is possible. Please confirm when the new set has been sent to him.
